inverse_MDS_comparisons

2023-10-31

# Steve's example, small circles on S^2 x S^2
data <- read.table(file = "../data/TorusToyEg.txt", header = FALSE)
data <- as.matrix(data, ncol = 6)
n <- nrow(data)
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)
dims <- c(2, 2)
plot3d(data[, 4:6],
  col = rainbow(n), xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1),
  zlim = c(-1, 1)
)

plot3d(data[, 1:3],
  col = rainbow(n), xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1),
  zlim = c(-1, 1)
)

data <- normalize_poly(data, dims)
angular <- FALSE
landmark_size <- .1
tol <- 5e-3
landmark_tol <- 5e-4

time <- Sys.time()
p_curve <- plot_MDS_py(x = data, dims = dims, landmark_size = landmark_size, angular = angular, tol = tol, landmark_tol = landmark_tol, gradient = TRUE)
## Message from pns() : dataset is on 4-sphere. 
##  .. sequential tests with significance level 0.1
## 4-sphere to 3-sphere, by SMALL sphere, p(LRT) = 2.81752e-05, p(vMF) = 0
## 3-sphere to 2-sphere, by SMALL sphere, p(LRT) = 0.0003717861, p(vMF) = 0
## 2-sphere to 1-sphere, by SMALL sphere, p(LRT) = 0.0002064328, p(vMF) = 0

## 
## length of BLUE from geodesic mean : 2.987093 (171 degree)
## length of RED from geodesic mean : -2.895391 (-166 degree)

## $stress_init
## [1] 0.1977402
## 
## $stress_final
## [1] 0.0001297418
## 
## $rstar
## [1] 1.414214
## 
## $r.hat
## [1] 1.03229

print(Sys.time() - time)
## Time difference of 12.64213 secs
close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 1, sharedMouse = TRUE)
plot3d(p_curve$MDS_data[, 1:3], col = rainbow(n))

knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)
close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)
res <- invert_MDS(x = data, result = p_curve, grid_size = 100, dims = dims, angular = FALSE, method = "NW", plot = TRUE)
plot3d(rbind(data[, 4:6], res[, 4:6]),
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = c(rainbow(n), rep("black", 100)), pch = 16
)

# Clusters on S^2
set.seed(100)
n <- 210
d <- 3
k <- 100
nspheres <- 1
cluster1 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
cluster2 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
cluster3 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
clusters <- rbind(cluster1, cluster2, cluster3)
col1 <- rep("#009999", (n / 3))
col2 <- rep("#FF0033", (n / 3))
col3 <- rep("#66FF00", (n / 3))
col <- c(col1, col2, col3)
close3d()
plot3d(clusters[, 1:3], col = col, xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1))

dims <- rep(2, nspheres)
angular <- FALSE
landmark_size <- .1
tol <- 5e-3
landmark_tol <- 5e-4

time <- Sys.time()
p_curve <- plot_MDS_py(x = clusters, dims = dims, landmark_size = landmark_size, angular = angular, tol = tol, landmark_tol = landmark_tol, col = col, gradient = TRUE)

print(Sys.time() - time)
close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 1, sharedMouse = TRUE)
sc <- march_PNS1_shapes(seq(0, p_curve$pns_info$radii[sum(dims)] * 2 * pi, l = 100),
  PNS = p_curve$pns_info
)
plot3d(rbind(p_curve$MDS_data, sc), col = c(col, rep("black", 100)), xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1))

knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)
close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 1, sharedMouse = TRUE)
res <- invert_MDS(x = clusters, result = p_curve, col = col, grid_size = 100, dims = dims, angular = FALSE, method = "NW", plot = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)

# Straight trends on (S^2)^2, small circles, offset by different amounts
set.seed(5)
n <- 200
nspheres <- 2
dims <- c(2, 2)
samp_3 <- cbind(r_path_s2r(n = n, r = 1, t = .7, sigma = 0.10)[, , 1], r_path_s2r(n = n, r = 1, t = -.4, sigma = 0.10)[, , 1])

clusters <- normalize_poly(samp_3, dims)

close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)
plot3d(
  clusters[, 1:3],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)

plot3d(
  clusters[, 4:6],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)

dims <- rep(2, nspheres)
angular <- FALSE
landmark_size <- .1
tol <- 5e-3
landmark_tol <- 5e-4

time <- Sys.time()
centroid_12 <- plot_MDS_py(x = clusters, dims = dims, landmark_size = landmark_size, angular = angular, tol = tol, landmark_tol = landmark_tol, gradient = TRUE)
## Message from pns() : dataset is on 4-sphere. 
##  .. sequential tests with significance level 0.1
## 4-sphere to 3-sphere, by SMALL sphere, p(LRT) = 0.03762211, p(vMF) = 0
## 3-sphere to 2-sphere, by SMALL sphere, p(LRT) = 0.0158801, p(vMF) = 0
## 2-sphere to 1-sphere, by SMALL sphere, p(LRT) = 1.880506e-88, p(vMF) = 0

## 
## length of BLUE from geodesic mean : 3.117865 (179 degree)
## length of RED from geodesic mean : -3.110514 (-178 degree)

## $stress_init
## [1] 0.02918435
## 
## $stress_final
## [1] 0.0004834534
## 
## $rstar
## [1] 1.414214
## 
## $r.hat
## [1] 1.206416

print(Sys.time() - time)
## Time difference of 15.53675 secs
close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)
res <- invert_MDS(x = clusters, result = centroid_12, grid_size = 100, dims = dims, method = "NW", angular = FALSE, plot = TRUE)

plot3d(rbind(clusters[, 4:6], res[, 4:6]),
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = c(rainbow(n), rep("black", 100)), pch = 16
)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)

# Straight trends on (S^2)^2, small circles, offset by .5, low variance
set.seed(5)
n <- 200
nspheres <- 2
samp_3 <- r_path_s2r(n = n, r = nspheres, t = c(.8), sigma = .02)

clusters1 <- samp_3[, , 1]
dims <- rep(2, nspheres)
for (i in (2:nspheres)) {
  clusters1 <- cbind(clusters1, samp_3[, , i])
}
clusters <- normalize_poly(clusters1, dims)

close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)
plot3d(
  clusters[, 1:3],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)

plot3d(
  clusters[, 4:6],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)

dims <- rep(2, nspheres)
angular <- FALSE
landmark_size <- .1
tol <- 5e-3
landmark_tol <- 5e-4

time <- Sys.time()
centroid_12 <- plot_MDS_py(x = clusters, dims = dims, landmark_size = landmark_size, angular = angular, tol = tol, landmark_tol = landmark_tol, gradient = TRUE)
## Message from pns() : dataset is on 4-sphere. 
##  .. sequential tests with significance level 0.1
## 4-sphere to 3-sphere, by SMALL sphere, p(LRT) = 2.412179e-31, p(vMF) = 0
## 3-sphere to 2-sphere, by GREAT sphere, p(LRT) = 0.1457618
## 2-sphere to 1-sphere, by GREAT sphere, p(LRT) = 0.6537475

## 
## length of BLUE from geodesic mean : 3.114585 (178 degree)
## length of RED from geodesic mean : -3.111888 (-178 degree)

## $stress_init
## [1] 1.302221
## 
## $stress_final
## [1] 0.0005802042
## 
## $rstar
## [1] 1.414214
## 
## $r.hat
## [1] 0.7417207

print(Sys.time() - time)
## Time difference of 11.72273 secs
close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)
res <- invert_MDS(x = clusters1, result = centroid_12, grid_size = 100, dims = dims, method = "NW", angular = FALSE, plot = TRUE)

plot3d(rbind(clusters[, 4:6], res[, 4:6]),
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = c(rainbow(n), rep("black", 100)), pch = 16
)
